WITH status_base AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(w.pricing_category, 'unknown') AS category,
    w.status_value,
    CASE
      WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '55%'
        THEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
      WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g') = ''
        THEN NULL
      ELSE '55' || regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
    END AS phone_norm,
    to_timestamp(w.status_timestamp::bigint) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo' AS ts_sp
  FROM whatsapp_inbound_log w
  WHERE w.event_type = 'status'
    AND w.status_timestamp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  category,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_value = 'sent')      AS sent,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_value = 'delivered') AS delivered,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_value = 'read')      AS read,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_value = 'failed')    AS failed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT phone_norm) FILTER (WHERE phone_norm IS NOT NULL) AS unique_recipients
FROM status_base
WHERE ts_sp >= '{{ $("Window Daily").item.json.start }}'
  AND ts_sp <  '{{ $("Window Daily").item.json.end }}'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

WITH orders_base AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.closed_at,
        o.total,
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(o.phone_e164, ''), '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '55%'
                THEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(o.phone_e164, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
            WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(o.phone_e164, ''), '\D', '', 'g') = ''
                THEN NULL
            ELSE '55' || regexp_replace(COALESCE(o.phone_e164, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
        END AS phone_norm
    FROM firebird_orders o
),
order_history AS (
    SELECT
        ob.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ob.phone_norm ORDER BY ob.closed_at) AS rn_lifetime,
        LAG(ob.closed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY ob.phone_norm ORDER BY ob.closed_at) AS prev_order_at
    FROM orders_base ob
),
marketing_delivered AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '55%'
                THEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
            WHEN regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g') = ''
                THEN NULL
            ELSE '55' || regexp_replace(COALESCE(w.status_recipient_id, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
        END AS phone_norm,
        to_timestamp(w.status_timestamp::bigint) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo' AS delivered_at
    FROM whatsapp_inbound_log w
    WHERE w.event_type = 'status'
      AND w.status_value = 'delivered'
      AND COALESCE(w.pricing_category, 'unknown') = 'marketing'
      AND w.status_timestamp IS NOT NULL
),
attrib AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.phone_norm,
        o.closed_at,
        o.total,
        o.rn_lifetime,
        o.prev_order_at,
        a.delivered_at
    FROM order_history o
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT m.delivered_at
        FROM marketing_delivered m
        WHERE m.phone_norm = o.phone_norm
          AND m.delivered_at <= o.closed_at
          AND o.closed_at < m.delivered_at + interval '7 days'
        ORDER BY m.delivered_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) a ON TRUE
    WHERE o.closed_at >= '{{ $("Window Daily").item.json.start }}'
      AND o.closed_at <  '{{ $("Window Daily").item.json.end }}'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS pedidos_atribuidos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phone_norm) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS clientes_convertidos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phone_norm) FILTER (
        WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL
          AND rn_lifetime = 1
    ) AS clientes_novos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phone_norm) FILTER (
        WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL
          AND rn_lifetime > 1
          AND prev_order_at IS NOT NULL
          AND prev_order_at < closed_at - interval '90 days'
    ) AS clientes_recuperados,
    COALESCE(SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS receita_atribuida
FROM attrib;
